thread:
mia (docs): Hey team — opened a docs PR to add a compact troubleshooting example for 429s + timeouts and a tiny SDK snippet showing graceful fallback. PTAL when you have a sec: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4829 :wave:

sam (sdk): Nice, saw the PR. Quick note — the JS snippet uses our old `retry_policy` param. SDKs now accept `x-retry` header. Can we show the header-based example instead?

mia (docs): Good catch. I copied the example from the internal runbook — will swap to header-based. Want me to include both patterns (header + param) with a note about deprecation?

alex (sre): Keep it minimal. Show header pattern as primary and add a one-line deprecated note. Also add a blurb about what triggers a 429 (burst vs sustained) and the difference between 429 and stream interrupts. Helps SRE triage.

mia (docs): Copy that. Adding a short sentence: "429s can be from sudden bursts (client-side retry storms) or sustained capacity limits — prefer exponential backoff with jitter and a max-retry cap."

sam (sdk): For the snippet, propose this backoff pseudo-code:

```
// exponential backoff w/ jitter
const base = 200; // ms
for (let i=0;i<maxRetries;i++) {
  await sleep(base * 2**i + random(0,100));
  // attach header: 'x-retry': i
}
```

mia (docs): Looks good. I'll paste that verbatim (shortened) into the code block.

jenna (pm): Heads-up — we need link anchors for the new section so other pages can reference the snippet from the SDK migration guide. Also can we add a small note recommending `canary` routing when rolling out fallback policies? That's product guidance.

mia (docs): Will add anchor `#retry-and-fallbacks` and a short callout about canaries. Question: do we want to recommend a default maxRetries=3 or 4?

alex (sre): Default 3. Also mention overall timeout budget — if the app-level deadline is 1s, don't retry aggressively. Maybe add a single sentence: "Bound retries to caller timeout (e.g., 3 attempts within caller budget)."

sam (sdk): One more SDK nit: the Python example should show how to add the header using our `client.headers.update({'x-retry': str(i)})` helper. I'll paste a 3-line snippet in review.

mia (docs): Sweet. Leaving a TODO in the PR to paste that.

docbot: buildbot/docs: CI started for PR #4829 — linting + linkcheck.

docbot: buildbot/docs: linkcheck found one broken link in `guides/migration.md` -> redirect loop at https://docs.redwood.ai/old-path -> marking for author.

mia (docs): Ack, I saw the linkcheck. That broken redirect was from the deprecated SDK page. I'll replace with the new sdk migration anchor.

jenna (pm): If link redirects are messy, we might want to add a short note in the migration guide about legacy redirects and an FAQ pointer. Not necessary for this PR, but file a follow-up?

mia (docs): I'll create a follow-up issue after this merges. For now, fixing the single link in this PR.

sam (sdk): Dropped a review with the Python snippet and a suggestion to use `X-Retry` (capitalization) in examples to match headers.md.

mia (docs): Updated PR: swapped param -> header examples, added anchor `#retry-and-fallbacks`, added one-line guidance on canary routing, default retries=3, and bound-to-caller-budget note. CI re-run queued.

docbot: buildbot/docs: CI passed for PR #4829 — lint OK, linkcheck OK.

alex (sre): :thumbsup: from SRE. Can someone from product ack the canary wording?

jenna (pm): Ack, wording is fine. Recommend a small follow-up to add a sample routing config snippet in the Dedicated runbook.

mia (docs): Marking follow-up: add routing config example to Dedicated runbook (created issue #1934). If no other blockers, I'll merge in ~30m after the green CI.

sam (sdk): No blockers from SDK. Thanks for doing the tidy up. :rocket:

mia (docs): Merged. Thanks all. Closing thread. :tada:
